highlights.headline: ‘Do you have to be dead?’: US coalminers plead for benefits as black-lung disease cases surge
highlights.summary: <p>Trump says he digs coal – but pneumoconiosis cases are at a 50-year high, and sick miners are mired in benefit delays</p><p>For 38 years, Josh Armes worked as a coal miner in West Virginia and Virginia.</p><p>After retirement, Armes, 74, of Grundy, Virginia, was diagnosed with black lung disease, <a href="https://www.lung.org/lung-health-diseases/lung-disease-lookup/black-lung">medically known</a> as coal workers’ pneumoconiosis (CWP), caused by breat

highlights.headline: India news: PM Modi says developing nations unfairly blamed for emissions
highlights.summary: PM Narendra Modi has told a climate conference that developed countries emit six times more CO2 than India. Meanwhile, an IIT Bombay professor has been accused of caste abuse. DW has more.

highlights.headline: Germany faces energy tax losses as EV sales rise
highlights.summary: The rapid shift to electric vehicles in Germany is cutting fuel tax revenue for the government. As EV sales surge, policymakers face growing pressure to find new ways to fund roads and transportation infrastructure.
